zh.title: 分词词典加载失败？先检查空行与重复键
zh.summary: 运行只读 UTF-8 词典检查器，定位空行、重复键、缺失映射和隐藏字符，明确主线修复与已发布安装包的边界。

en.title: Dictionary loading failed? Check blank lines and duplicate keys
en.summary: Run a read-only UTF-8 dictionary inspector to locate blank lines, duplicate keys, missing mappings and hidden characters, with explicit source-versus-package boundaries.

zh.title: 先检查音频输入：WAV、裸 PCM 与采样率
zh.summary: 用可直接运行的 PCM16 WAV 检查器核对帧数、时长与峰值，区分文件检查、重采样和真实识别验收。

en.title: Check the audio input first: WAV, raw PCM and sample rate
en.summary: Run a PCM16 WAV inspector to verify frames, duration and peak amplitude, while keeping file checks separate from resampling and ASR acceptance.

zh.title: 换了模型却没生效？核对 WebSocket 启动配置

en.title: Changed the model, but not the result? Check the WebSocket configuration
en.summary: Separate offline and streaming models, inspect argument routing without loading weights, then plan acceptance on real recordings.

zh.title: 热词没有生效？先核对传递链路和安装包
zh.summary: 从 WebSocket 消息到 Torch 独立运行时，核对热词格式、安装版本和批次时间戳，避免把接口修复当作准确率保证。

en.title: Hotwords not working? Check the request path and installed package
en.summary: Check hotword encoding, standalone package versions and batched timestamps, without confusing interface fixes with recognition accuracy guarantees.

zh.title: 微调后，怎样确认模型真的更好？
zh.summary: 从一次持续学习反馈出发，先验证评测尺子，再选择 checkpoint，最后检查真实服务。

en.title: Did fine-tuning actually make your model better?
en.summary: Validate the ruler, choose a checkpoint under old-domain constraints, then test the real service.
